title: Murder at Blackwood Manor
description: Lord Blackwood is dead. You and Rem must explore the rooms, interrogate suspects, and collect physical evidence to find the killer, weapon, and motive before the snowstorm subsides.

locations.name: Grand Library
locations.desc: The room is dark, smell of mahogany and tobacco. Lord Blackwood's body lies slumped over his desk. A broken teacup sits nearby.

locations.name: Boudoir
locations.desc: Lady Blackwood's private sitting room. Plush velvet chairs, cosmetics on the vanity, and a massive mahogany bookshelf.

locations.name: Servants Quarters
locations.desc: Arthur's room. Neat, sparse, and clean. A wool uniform hangs in the wardrobe.

locations.name: Manor Kitchen
locations.desc: Smells of garlic and roasting meat. Large cutting boards, copper pots, and a locked pantry cabinet.

locations.name: Conservatory
locations.desc: A glassy greenhouse filled with exotic plants and shadows. Rain batters the panes, and dirt-covered tools sit in the corner.

suspects.name: Lady Blackwood
suspects.bio: Cold, aristocratic, and fiercely protective of her social standing. She married Lord Blackwood for status, but his mounting debts threatened to ruin them.
suspects.motive: To secure the inheritance and property before Lord Blackwood could liquidate it to pay off his massive gambling debts.

suspects.name: Arthur
suspects.bio: Dressed in a tweed suit, he has served the family for 15 years. Extremely formal, but his hands shake slightly when pouring tea.
suspects.motive: Lord Blackwood fired him the night before without a pension. Arthur's sick daughter depends on the family's financial aid.

suspects.name: Chef Charles
suspects.bio: A hot-tempered cook who constantly mutters under his breath. He had shouting matches with Lord Blackwood about wages and respect.
suspects.motive: Lord Blackwood threatened to blacklist him from cooking in London after Charles was caught stealing fine wines from the cellar.

weapons.name: Heavy Candlestick
weapons.desc: A heavy solid-brass candlestick stained with old wax. Ideal for a blunt strike.

weapons.name: Cyanide Vial
weapons.desc: A tiny glass bottle with a skull label, smelling faintly of bitter almonds.

weapons.name: Carving Knife
weapons.desc: A razor-sharp chef's carving knife from the kitchen display.

clues.name: Torn Will
clues.desc: A shredded legal document showing Lord Blackwood intended to rewrite his will and cut off Lady Blackwood completely.

clues.name: Tweed Scrap
clues.desc: A small scrap of grey tweed wool fabric matching Arthur's butler uniform, snagged on a desk drawer latch.

clues.name: Botany Journal
clues.desc: A guide detailing toxic mushrooms and plant poisons, with Charles' initials on the cover.

clues.name: Spare Key
clues.desc: A bronze key that fits the locked cabinet where kitchen poison was stored, found under the library rug.

title: The Neo-Tokyo Core Heist
description: A high-security neural prototype core has been stolen from the Arasaka Penthouse. You and Rem have been hired as corporate investigators to solve the hack and identify the thief.

locations.name: Penthouse Vault
locations.desc: The steel door has been cleanly deactivated. The prototype glass tube is shattered, and residual liquid nitrogen drips onto the neon floor.

locations.name: Server Deck
locations.desc: A freezing room filled with glowing mainframe towers and hum of cooling fans. Level-5 security login required.

locations.name: Locker Room
locations.desc: The security team's lounge. Heavy weapon racks, gear storage lockers, and a scent of synthetic oil.

locations.name: Fixer Suite
locations.desc: Jaxx's workspace. Luxury holographic displays, fine leather chairs, and a bar stocked with premium synthetic whiskey.

locations.name: Rooftop Helipad
locations.desc: Wind whips the rain across the rooftop landing zone. An automated drone carrier is docked here waiting for clearance.

suspects.name: V01D
suspects.bio: A silent freelance netrunner wearing a glowing visor. Claims he was only scanning traffic for public glitches.
suspects.motive: Rival syndicate Militech offered him a bounty to steal the prototype code to cure his deteriorating cyber-neural condition.

suspects.name: Buster
suspects.bio: An imposing security chief with heavy chrome implants. Claims the camera network was looped from the outside.
suspects.motive: Deeply in debt to the yakuza syndicates, who threatened to deactivate his cybernetics if he didn't allow their operatives access.

suspects.name: Jaxx
suspects.bio: A smooth-talking coordinator who arranged the vault codes. Insists he was in a secure boardroom during the hack.
suspects.motive: He was passed over for promotion to Arasaka Director, and wanted to leak the core schematics to destroy the rival project's value.

weapons.name: Quantum Decrypter
weapons.desc: A modified data slate with custom bypass software used to loop Arasaka mainframe protocols.

weapons.name: Shock Baton
weapons.desc: A heavy police-grade tactical baton that causes electrical feedback in neural cybernetics.

weapons.name: Laser Cutter
weapons.desc: A pocket industrial-grade micro laser tool capable of cutting vault wires.

clues.name: Datapad
clues.desc: A datapad containing decrypted core schematics and communication logs with a Militech contact.

clues.name: Yakuza Token
clues.desc: A gold-pressed credential coin representing yakuza debts, found stashed in Buster's locker.

clues.name: Corporate Keycard
clues.desc: A level-5 corporate keycard logged entering the vault room precisely 3 minutes before the alarm loop began.

clues.name: Decryption Slate
clues.desc: A decryption slate showing cybernetic bypass logs matching V01D's unique netrunner neural signature.

title: The Red Velvet Club Betrayal
description: Rain beats down on the neon-lit alleyways of 1947 Chicago. Inside the smokey Red Velvet Club, informant Johnny Malone is found strangled in his dressing room. Rem and you have until the police arrive to untangle conflicting alibis, expose hidden motives, and catch the killer.

locations.name: Backstage Dressing Room
locations.desc: Smells of cheap perfume, hairspray, and copper. Johnny lies slumped over the dressing table vanity, eyes wide. The backstage piano sits open.

locations.name: Main Stage
locations.desc: A circular stage with a spotlight beating on an empty microphone stand. Instruments sit abandoned. The bar counter is just off to the left.

locations.name: Leo's Darkroom
locations.desc: Bathed in a red glow. Wet photos hang on clotheslines to dry. Chemical baths smell of sulfur and vinegar.

locations.name: Mickey's Office
locations.desc: A mahogany desk dominates the room. Safe in the wall is closed. Venetian blinds filter the neon buzz of the club sign.

locations.name: VIP Lounge Corner
locations.desc: An exclusive dimly-lit booths area overlooking the stage, curtained off. Smells of expensive velvet and stale smoke.

locations.name: Rainy Back Alley
locations.desc: The wet, trash-strewn alley behind the club. A neon light casts a reddish glow over a metal fire escape. A locked green dumpster sits nearby.

suspects.name: Vixen Val
suspects.bio: Johnny's former flame. Singing tonight at the club. Beautiful, but her mascara is smudged and she keeps wringing a handkerchief.
suspects.motive: Johnny threatened to leak her dark past to the newspapers, destroying her rising career in the music scene.
suspects.alibi: She claims she was performing on stage from 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and insists Leo can verify she didn't leave.

suspects.name: Mickey
suspects.bio: A heavy-set man in a double-breasted suit, chewing an unlit cigar. He runs the club with an iron fist and loans money to desperate patrons.
suspects.motive: Johnny was an FBI informant about to testify about Mickey's illegal gambling syndicate and mob ties.
suspects.alibi: Insists he was locked in his private office drafting contract notes from 9:00 PM to 9:30 PM, and saw nobody.

suspects.name: Leo
suspects.bio: A nervous man with wire glasses and camera strapped to his neck. His fingers are stained with chemicals.
suspects.motive: Johnny found Leo's hidden negatives of cheating spouses and threatened to expose Leo's blackmail operation.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was locked in his darkroom developing film from 8:45 PM to 9:15 PM and saw no one.

suspects.name: Buster
suspects.bio: An imposing man in a tight suit. Mickey's loyal enforcer. Guarding the backstage corridor all evening.
suspects.motive: Johnny discovered Buster was skimming money from Mickey's blackjack tables and threatened to tell Mickey.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was standing guard at the backstage dressing room corridor door from 9:00 PM to 9:20 PM, then stepped to the alley for a smoke.

suspects.name: Dr. Evelyn Vance
suspects.bio: A sophisticated woman in a heavy fur coat and dark veil. A private psychiatrist who frequently visits Mickey's backroom gambling table.
suspects.motive: Johnny stole her clinical files containing blackmail material on city officials and illegal drug prescriptions.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was sitting at the VIP Lounge Corner table from 8:50 PM to 9:30 PM, and never approached backstage.

weapons.name: Piano Wire
weapons.desc: A thin, high-tension steel wire snapped off the backstage dressing room piano, stained with blood.

weapons.name: Poisoned Bourbon
weapons.desc: A glass of premium whiskey sitting on Johnny's table, containing trace sediments of white arsenic powder.

weapons.name: Snub-Nose .38
weapons.desc: A small caliber police revolver stashed behind the bar register with one spent shell.

weapons.name: Medical Syringe
weapons.desc: A medical syringe containing trace residue of fast-acting digitalis poison.

clues.name: Arsenic Vial
clues.desc: A small apothecary vial containing rat poison, found hidden inside Vixen Val's makeup vanity box.

clues.name: Blackmail Negatives
clues.desc: Holographic photograph negatives showing Mickey meeting with Chicago's major syndicate bosses.

clues.name: Signed Promissory Note
clues.desc: A signed note confirming Johnny owed Mickey $10,000, with a handwritten threat 'Pay up or sleep' written on it.

clues.name: Malone's Ledger
clues.desc: Johnny Malone's pocket ledger containing names of blackmailed patrons and Leo's darkroom combination code.

clues.name: Skimming Records
clues.desc: A small ledger logging casino table cuts, proving Buster was stealing money from Mickey.

clues.name: Mob Prescriptions
clues.desc: Doctor prescriptions signed by Vance authorizing lethal narcotics for syndicates, stuffed under the booth seat.

clues.name: Silver Lighter
clues.desc: A monogrammed silver lighter with the initials 'B.G.', found inside the backstage piano casing.

contradictions.description: Val claims Leo saw her on stage between 9:00 PM and 9:30 PM, but Leo claims he was locked in the darkroom from 8:45 PM to 9:15 PM.
Mickey claims he stayed locked in his office all night, but Val mentions seeing Mickey pacing near the backstage hallway at 9:10 PM.
Buster claims he was guarding the door from 9:00 PM to 9:20 PM, but Leo claims he saw Buster walking towards the back alley at 9:05 PM.
Evelyn claims she sat in the VIP Corner from 8:50 PM to 9:30 PM, but Mickey states the corner table was empty at 9:15 PM.
Buster claims he has not entered the dressing room all night, but his monogrammed lighter was found in the dressing room piano.

title: The Hotel Eutopia Closed-Space Mystery
description: A devastating blizzard has trapped you and Rem inside Hotel Eutopia, a fading art-deco resort perched over a frozen gorge. Lord Sterling Vance is found poisoned in the Grand Ballroom. With cut power lines, a failing heating system, and a murderer among you who will resort to violence to escape, you must survive and solve the case before the cold gets you.

locations.name: Grand Lobby
locations.desc: A fading art-deco lobby with high columns, blocked revolving doors piled with snow, and a large fireplace struggling to warm the room.

locations.name: Grand Ballroom
locations.desc: Lord Sterling's body lies in a velvet armchair near the frozen fireplace. Crystal chandeliers hum faintly from the flickering backup generator.

locations.name: Suite 404
locations.desc: Lady Beatrice's luxurious suite. Heavy velvet drapes, a vanity table with spilled lavender water, and a desk with locked drawers.

locations.name: Wine Cellar
locations.desc: A chilly underground cellar with rows of dusty wine bottles. A metal service hatch leads to the Boiler Room.

locations.name: Boiler Room
locations.desc: A warm but hazardous basement chamber filled with roaring pipes and high-pressure steam valves. Vents hiss in the dark.

locations.name: Elevator Shaft
locations.desc: The metal elevator doors are pried open, exposing the dark shaft where a frayed steel cable holds the unstable cage in place.

locations.name: Rooftop Observatory
locations.desc: A high dome with a large brass telescope. Snow lashes against the glass panels, and the freezing wind is deafening.

locations.name: Hotel Kitchen
locations.desc: The large culinary area. Cold copper pots are scattered, stoves are cold, and a heavy wooden chopping block sits in the center.

locations.name: Library Room
locations.desc: Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves housing old maps and Vance family archives. A leather chair sits by a window overlooking the gorge.

locations.name: Staff Quarters
locations.desc: Simple living units for the hotel staff. A small dresser and narrow iron cots. Damp clothes hang on lines.

locations.name: Courtyard Garden
locations.desc: The hotel's courtyard, buried under three feet of fresh snow. A marble fountain is frozen solid, and stone arches cast long shadows.

locations.name: Laundry Room
locations.desc: Smells of bleach and damp fabric. Large rotary washing machines sit silent, and deep steel sinks are filled with grey water.

suspects.name: Lady Beatrice Vance
suspects.bio: Sterling's haughty wife. Draped in expensive furs, she maintains a facade of grief but is secretly bankrupt and was about to be disinherited.
suspects.motive: To secure the inheritance before Sterling could file divorce papers and cut her out of his will completely.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was resting in Suite 404 from 10:00 PM to 10:45 PM, attended by her sister Evelyn.

suspects.name: Dr. Evelyn Vance
suspects.bio: Beatrice's quiet sister. She carried the cardiac medications for Sterling, but hides a deep resentment of Beatrice.
suspects.motive: Secretly in love with Sterling, she poisoned him in a jealous rage after learning he was planning to flee the country alone.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was in Suite 404 administering Beatrice's sleeping drops between 10:00 PM and 10:30 PM.

suspects.name: Mickey Malone
suspects.bio: A guest in a tailored suit who runs Chicago's gambling operations. Claims he was only here for the mountain air.
suspects.motive: Sterling owed his syndicate $50,000 in debts and refused to hand over the deeds to the Hotel Eutopia as collateral.
suspects.alibi: Insists he was playing cards in the Library Room with Grace Harper from 9:45 PM to 10:30 PM.

suspects.name: Julian Mercer
suspects.bio: A creepily polite young man who runs hotel operations. He knows the building's layout better than anyone.
suspects.motive: He is Sterling's unrecognized illegitimate son, seeking retribution for a lifetime of poverty and abandonment.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was fixing a pipe in the Laundry Room from 10:15 PM to 10:45 PM.

suspects.name: Vixen Val
suspects.bio: The resident jazz singer. Beautiful and guarded. She is secretly working as Mickey's informant in the hotel.
suspects.motive: Sterling found out she was spying for Malone and threatened to expose her criminal record to the federal authorities.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was rehearsing on the piano in the Grand Ballroom from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM, all by herself.

suspects.name: Aiden Thorne
suspects.bio: A sharp, cynical reporter stranded by the storm. He is Beatrice's nephew, hunting for a scoop.
suspects.motive: To blackmail Sterling with proof of his financial crimes, but Sterling refused to pay and threatened his life.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in the Rooftop Observatory taking notes on the storm from 10:00 PM to 10:40 PM.

suspects.name: Chef Charles
suspects.bio: A hot-tempered culinary chef who was caught screaming at Sterling in the kitchen earlier that evening.
suspects.motive: Sterling fired him hours before the blizzard for refusing to serve spoiled meats to guests, ruining his reputation.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was alone in the Staff Quarters packing his knives and luggage from 10:00 PM to 10:50 PM.

suspects.name: Arthur Pendelton
suspects.bio: Sterling's loyal butler for 30 years. Rigid and quiet, but knows every family dispute and dark secret.
suspects.motive: Sterling was planning to close the hotel and abandon the staff, leaving Arthur with nothing after a lifetime of service.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was cleaning the silver cabinets in the Grand Lobby from 10:00 PM to 10:35 PM.

suspects.name: Sterling Vance Jr.
suspects.bio: Sterling's estranged son who arrived secretly. He is carrying a concealed military sidearm.
suspects.motive: His father disinherited him in favor of Beatrice, leaving him broke and facing military court-martial debts.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was hiding out in the Courtyard Garden to avoid an confrontation with his father from 10:10 PM to 10:40 PM.

suspects.name: Grace Harper
suspects.bio: The co-owner of Hotel Eutopia. Highly stressed and desperate to keep the hotel afloat.
suspects.motive: Sterling backed out of a merger deal at the last minute, which would result in the immediate bank foreclosure of the hotel.
suspects.alibi: Claims she was reviewing accounts in the Library Room with Mickey Malone from 9:45 PM to 10:30 PM.

weapons.name: Digitalis Poison
weapons.desc: A small medical ampoule containing concentrated digitalis cardiac glycosides, lethal in high doses.

weapons.name: Fire Axe
weapons.desc: A heavy, red-painted rescue axe pulled from the Lobby's safety glass box.

weapons.name: Strangle Cord
weapons.desc: A thick length of waxed cord used for bundling laundry sheets, capable of silent strangulation.

weapons.name: Lead Pipe
weapons.desc: A solid, heavy plumbing lead pipe covered in rust and industrial grease.

weapons.name: Kitchen Cleaver
weapons.desc: A broad, razor-sharp steel cleaver used for cutting meats, stamped with Chef Charles' initials.

clues.name: Syringe Case
clues.desc: A small velvet-lined case containing a medical syringe and trace residues of cardiac fluid, found hidden in Evelyn's room.

clues.name: Torn Will Draft
clues.desc: A torn draft of Lord Sterling's will, showing he intended to leave Beatrice with nothing, found in a vanity desk.

clues.name: Bloodied Towel
clues.desc: A damp hotel bath towel stained with blood and soot, stuffed deep inside a dirty linen laundry bin.

clues.name: Boiler Key
clues.desc: A master boiler maintenance keycard belonging to the concierge, found hidden under a wine barrel rack.

clues.name: Elevator Guide
clues.desc: An elevator schematic and maintenance manual detailing how to override door locks, found in the concierge desk.

clues.name: Safe Schematics
clues.desc: Wall safe schematics matching Sterling's private office safe, annotated with Mickey's hand-written notes, found in a ballroom sofa.

clues.name: Blackmail Note
clues.desc: A scrap of writing pad paper stating: 'Pay by midnight or the world knows about Beatrice's debts', found under a library book.

clues.name: Broken Watch
clues.desc: A silver military pocket watch, smashed at exactly 10:15 PM, matching Sterling Jr.'s initials, found in the elevator grease.

clues.name: Silver Cufflink
clues.desc: A silver initialed monogram cufflink matching Arthur's butler uniform, found snagged on the ballroom curtain.

clues.name: Military Pistol
clues.desc: A standard army-issue .45 automatic pistol, cold to the touch, hidden inside a hollow tree trunk in the garden.

contradictions.description: Beatrice claims Evelyn was with her from 10:00 PM to 10:45 PM, but Evelyn states she left Beatrice's bedroom at 10:30 PM.
Mickey claims he played cards with Grace in the library until 10:30 PM, but Arthur saw Grace leaving for the laundry room at 10:10 PM.
Julian claims he was in the laundry room from 10:15 PM to 10:45 PM, but Charles mentions hearing Julian's voice arguing in the cellar at 10:20 PM.
Aiden claims he was in the observatory from 10:00 PM to 10:40 PM, but Val heard footsteps moving through the library corridor at 10:15 PM.
Sterling Jr. claims he was in the garden from 10:10 PM to 10:40 PM, but Arthur saw snow tracks leading from the lobby to the elevator corridor at 10:15 PM.
Arthur claims he remained in the lobby cleaning silver until 10:35 PM, but Grace notes Arthur was absent when she passed through the lobby at 10:25 PM.
